title: Diagonal evaluation against the shifted normal determinant
statement: Let S be a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] scheme, let f:X\to S be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and smooth of relative dimension d≥0 [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let R:D_QCoh(O_X)\to D_QCoh(O_S) be a functor whose composition with the full-subcategory inclusion is isomorphic to the restriction of derived direct image Rf_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and let a be its specified right adjoint. Let O be an object in D_QCoh(O_S) whose underlying object is isomorphic to the structure sheaf in degree zero [def-pc-derived-category]. Put M=Ω¹_{X/S} [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf] and M^dual=Hom_{O_X}(M,O_X), the internal sheaf Hom. Then in the recorded derived tensor category [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] there is an isomorphism a(O)\otimes^L (\bigwedge^d M^dual)[-d]\cong O_X[0], where the exterior power is the sheafification of sectionwise exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. The derived categories for X and S may be chosen in different universes.

proof.text: Properness and finite type make X and P=X times_S X Noetherian. Use standard derived localizations for P and all its opens. Obtain the preservation witness and a right adjoint c for the diagonal from the Noetherian adjoint theorem. The single structure complex of P has quasi-coherent cohomology: degree zero is O_P, and all other homology sheaves are zero. It therefore defines OP in D_QCoh(P).

Smoothness implies flatness. The smooth diagonal theorem supplies perfection of the pushed-forward structure complex. Apply perfectDiagonal_dualizing_evaluation with the specified R, comparison, a, adj, O and hO and the chosen diagonal adjunction c. This gives e: a(O) tensor c(OP) isomorphic to the derived tensor unit.

Apply smoothDiagonal_dualizing_determinant to the same c, adjunction and OP to get n: c(OP) isomorphic to the shifted determinant of the dual of relative differentials. Tensor n inverse with the identity on a(O) and compose with e. This is precisely the stated evaluation isomorphism.
